definitions.en: To hand over, to give/pass something to someone; to assign or entrust a task
definitions.es: Entregar, ceder algo a alguien; asignar o encomendar una tarea
definitions.fr: Remettre, transmettre quelque chose à quelqu'un ; confier ou assigner une tâche
definitions.hi: किसी को कुछ सौंपना; कोई काम सौंपना या देना
definitions.ja: 手渡す、引き渡す；任務を割り当てる・任せる
definitions.km: ប្រគល់ ឬ ផ្ទេរអ្វីមួយឱ្យអ្នកណាម្នាក់; ចាត់តាំង ឬ ប្រគល់ភារកិច្ច
definitions.ne: कसैलाई केही सुम्पनु; कुनै काम दिनु वा सुम्पनु
definitions.pt: Entregar, passar algo a alguém; atribuir ou confiar uma tarefa
definitions.th: มอบ, ส่งมอบสิ่งของให้ใครสักคน; มอบหมายงาน
definitions.tl: Ibigay, ihatid ang isang bagay sa isang tao; magtalaga ng gawain
definitions.ur: کسی کو کچھ سونپنا؛ کوئی کام تفویض کرنا
definitions.vi: Trao, bàn giao thứ gì cho ai; giao nhiệm vụ hoặc phân công
definitions.zh: 移交，递交；分配或委托任务
definitions.zh_Hant: 移交，遞交；分配或委託任務
